Allow MCP clients to create/modify objec: 允许 MCP 客户端创建/修改对象和写入文件（set_object、write_file 工具）。默认关闭。
Allow MCP clients to write state values: 允许 MCP 客户端写入状态值（set_state 工具）
As a web extension the selected web inst: As a web extension the selected web instance provides the login: OAuth must be enabled there as well ('Allow third-party clients'), otherwise MCP clients only get a redirect to the login page, which they cannot use.
Default user for authentication (e.g., ': 默认身份验证用户（例如，“admin”）
Enable 'Authentication' first — without: Enable 'Authentication' first — without it the MCP endpoint is open and OAuth has nothing to protect.
Enable HTTPS/SSL for secure connections: 启用 HTTPS/SSL 以建立安全连接
Enable ioBroker user authentication for: 为 Web 服务器启用 ioBroker 用户身份验证
Enter an address like https://iobroker.e: Enter an address like https://iobroker.example.com - scheme and host only, no path
Externally reachable address of this ser: Externally reachable address of this server, without a path. Required behind a reverse proxy. As a web extension it must match the public URL of the web instance.
服务器绑定的 IP 地址（所有接口均为 0.0.0.0）
MCP clients register themselves automati: MCP clients register themselves automatically. With this off, every client has to be registered by hand before it can connect.
MCP clients such as Claude Desktop conne: MCP clients such as Claude Desktop connect through a browser login instead of a token you create by hand. The client never sees the ioBroker password and discovers the server on its own.
OAuth without HTTPS: remote MCP clients: OAuth without HTTPS: remote MCP clients refuse plain http:// and will not be able to connect. Enable SSL, or put this server behind an https reverse proxy and set the public URL.
Path to the chained certificate file (op: 链式证书文件的路径（可选）
